title: Wyvern Poison

sources.title: Wyvern Poison
markers: {{rare|Wyvern Poison}} is a [[Consumables|Consumable]] ([[Coatings|Coating]]). It can be applied to a weapon to give it special properties for ten turns or thrown as a [[Grenades|Grenade]] to inflict its effects in an area.

summary: Early Access coating that added 3d6 Poison on an attack.

fields.Legacy effect: Single-use Bonus Action coating for up to 10 turns. Adds 3d6 Poison damage on an attack, with a DC 15 Constitution save for half.
fields.Availability: Early Access only. Replaced by Wyvern Toxin in the released game. The source lists no verified Early Access splash mechanics.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
